turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m a 31-year-old woman, and I’ve had intermittent flank pain for about five months. I’ve also had five urinary tract infections over the past two years, but I don’t have any recent fever, nausea, or vomiting, and my urinary habits are mostly unchanged except during a UTI.

turns.doctor_question: Do you often find yourself needing to rush to the bathroom to urinate, or feeling like you can't hold your urine for a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t usually feel a sudden urgency or have trouble holding my urine; that mainly happens only when I’m in the middle of a urinary tract infection.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any firm lumps or masses in your breast that feel distinct from the rest of the tissue?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any firm lumps or distinct masses in my breast. If you’d like, I can tell you more about the timing and location of the flank pain.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, firm bumps on your skin that are smooth to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any small, firm bumps on my skin—nothing that feels smooth to the touch. I’d be happy to describe where the flank pain is located and how often it comes and goes.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you've been having trouble cooling down or regulating your body temperature lately, even when you're not feeling hot or exercising?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed trouble regulating my body temperature or cooling down; I haven’t felt persistently hot or had any temperature-related symptoms.

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or anxiety in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I’ve mostly been feeling okay day to day, aside from the intermittent flank pain over the past five months. I don’t think stress or anxiety has been unusually high lately, and I haven’t had any persistent fever or other systemic symptoms.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching sensations on your skin lately, either all over or in specific areas?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had itching sensations on my skin either all over or in specific areas. If there’s any discomfort, it’s mainly the intermittent flank pain, and it hasn’t been accompanied by rash or skin changes.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on your arms?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on my arms. The main issue I’ve had is the intermittent flank pain, and I haven’t seen any skin changes that go along with it.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any trouble finding the right words when you're talking, like if you're trying to say something but can't quite think of the word you want to use?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any trouble finding the right words or any noticeable changes in my speech or thinking. I can tell you the flank pain comes and goes intermittently over the last five months, and it isn’t usually accompanied by nausea, vomiting, or fever.”

turns.doctor_question: I'm here to help you, and I want to make sure I'm getting a complete picture of what's going on. Can you tell me if your muscles feel stiff or hard to move, even when you're trying to relax?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t feel muscle stiffness or hard-to-move muscles when I’m trying to relax. The main ongoing issue is the intermittent flank pain over the past five months, without other systemic symptoms.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling today? Have you felt unusually sleepy or struggled to stay awake, even when you're doing things you normally enjoy or when you're in a situation where you'd expect to be alert?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t felt unusually sleepy, and I haven’t had trouble staying awake—I feel alert for the most part. The main thing affecting me is the intermittent flank pain, with no other major symptoms.
